draft_args.prompt: [Look: 1950s black-and-white TV ad.] [A man in a fedora clutches his stomach beside a cardboard city; at 3 s he drinks a fizzing glass; at 6 s a rubber-suit lizard monster behind him also drinks one and calmly sits down.] [Eyes on the glass.] Single shot: medium shot, 35mm, eye level, static camera, one continuous 10 s take. Eyelines: everyone looks at the product and each other, never into the lens; faces in profile or three-quarter. Motion carries on through the last half second. [Adults only, no kids. Invented characters; a named real person becomes only their moves and attitude, never their likeness. No gore; bloodstains on clothing are fine, no blood draining out. Nobody looks into the camera. Parody brands only; no real brands or personal names on screen.]
